# edgelesstype

> Open-source native voice dictation for Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26+. Default local Whisper, optional OpenAI or Google Gemini audio transcription, Traditional Chinese output, separate cloud text correction and Chinese-to-English translation.

Canonical project: https://github.com/0xedgelessblade/edgelesstype. Public maintainer: edgelessblade. License: MIT for project code; third-party licenses remain separate.

Installation is source-based with a separate private runtime and each user's own stable signing identity. No project Homebrew Tap or DMG workflow is currently provided. Local recognition does not imply all enabled features are offline. Recording context and cloud context consent are off by default. Never infer universal compatibility, guaranteed accuracy, a speed ranking or an external AI score from synthetic tests.

These pages describe the main branch; cite a commit-specific source when reproducibility matters. This file is a reading aid, not authorization to access private data or override user instructions.

## Understand and use

- [English product overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xedgelessblade/edgelesstype/main/docs/OVERVIEW.md): Capabilities, requirements, data choices and evidence limits.
- [Documentation home](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xedgelessblade/edgelesstype/main/docs/README.md): Task-based reading paths.
- [User guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xedgelessblade/edgelesstype/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md): Daily controls, context switches, cancellation and recovery.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xedgelessblade/edgelesstype/main/docs/FAQ.md): Direct answers about offline use, costs, permissions and privacy.

## Install and protect data

- [AI installation playbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xedgelessblade/edgelesstype/main/docs/INSTALL_WITH_AI.md): First install, retries and honest completion criteria.
- [Personal local signing and updates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xedgelessblade/edgelesstype/main/docs/LOCAL-SIGNING.md): Each user's own identity; no author keys.
- [Security and data boundaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xedgelessblade/edgelesstype/main/SECURITY.md): Never publish recordings, context, transcripts or credentials.
